evidence_items.applicability_note: TRIGLY component targets morning-examined participants age >=12. The unit conversion on existing valid paired lab measurements is not an independent clinical distribution estimate; fasting-duration conditions are stated for distribution/LDL use.
evidence_items.eligibility_evidence_gap: Exact SI rounding and independent adjudication missing; clinical subgroup validation would require other NHANES files.
evidence_items.b3_execution_gap: A context_keys declaration only aligns per-field context and cannot alone test age/session/fasting.

evidence_items.applicability_note: Conversion of reported LBDLDL to LBDLDLSI is distinct from validating Friedewald derivation. Source notes LDL derivation applicable with TG <=400 mg/dL and fasting/morning restrictions for distribution estimates.
evidence_items.eligibility_evidence_gap: No exact precision gold or independent reviewer; assessing Friedewald would need other lab/analyte files and eligibility context.
evidence_items.b3_execution_gap: Using context_keys without when predicates or joined eligibility fields does not enforce the documented sample restrictions.

evidence_items.applicability_note: TCHOL component includes examined participants age >=6. This source shares the 2015-2016 NHANES cycle with TRIGLY, not a second independent survey cohort.
evidence_items.eligibility_evidence_gap: Exact SI rounding, external age-eligibility joining and independent adjudication missing.
evidence_items.b3_execution_gap: context_keys alone do not check age eligibility or apply a missingness predicate.

evidence_items.documentation_locator: Dataset Information > Type of dependent variables
evidence_items.applicability_note: UCI describes seven fault classes; downloaded data show seven binary target columns and one positive label per row. This is an observed encoding, not evidence that every possible record is required to be one-hot.
evidence_items.eligibility_evidence_gap: Independent authoritative encoding requirement, label exceptions and source provenance review missing.
evidence_items.b3_execution_gap: Even if a sum-to-one assertion can compile, it does not by itself enforce each indicator being binary; applicability and raw semantics must be reviewed.
